title: [Audit] Kibana session reconstruction
description: Replays one person’s Kibana session. Filter to a session id (hover a cell, Filter for value), then sort Time ascending to read it forward. Kibana events only, newest 1,000 in range at most.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE service.name == "serverless-kibana" | WHERE kibana.session.id IS NOT NULL | WHERE event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time", "saved_object_close_point_in_time", "space_get", "space_find") OR (event.action == "http_request" AND (NOT body.text LIKE "*/api/*" OR body.text LIKE "*/api/ui_counters/*" OR body.text LIKE "*/api/content_management/*"))) | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1000 | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)") | EVAL verb = CASE(event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | EVAL op = CASE(verb != "other", verb, COALESCE(REPLACE(event.action, "_", " "), "other")) | KEEP @timestamp, actor, kibana.session.id, op, kibana.saved_object.type, kibana.saved_object.name, kibana.space.id, body.text | EVAL actor = REPLACE(REPLACE(actor, "^([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15} · Cloud API key$", "$1… · Cloud API key"), "^Unnamed key of ([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15}$", "Unnamed key of $1…") | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, op AS Operation, kibana.saved_object.type AS `Object type`, kibana.saved_object.name AS Object, kibana.space.id AS Space, body.text AS Message
